text:
Maya Patel: quick midday status - cut window is open, merged release-candidate -> main, started canary at 10:12. nothing in canary errors yet.
Ben Cho: thanks. i'm still picking through the backport for infra-metrics (PR #2431) — need one more review + my fix for flaky test. pinging @Anna for a quick look.
Anna Rivera: on it, will try to review this afternoon. rough glance shows the test flakes on the prometheus mock timing. i can add a tighter wait.
Devon Li: FYI the autoscaler bumped a replica unexpectedly on the canary host at 10:35, i dug into logs - saw OOM kill for lm-serving-worker-3. I scaled it to 2x for the canary pool to keep latency stable.
Maya Patel: good catch. Devon, can you post the `kubectl` snippet you used? ops wants the command for runbook.
Devon Li: sure: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment/lm-serving-canary --replicas=2 && kubectl -n inference logs deployment/lm-serving-canary --since=10m```
Samir Khatri: noticed a routing fallback during a brief spike to fallback-model-small for a customer route — investigating if batching thresholds triggered it. looks like batching window got longer, causing token timeout and fallback.
Maya Patel: blocker status: we have two soft blockers: (1) PR #2431 needs one more reviewer (Anna) and (2) investigate autoscaler churn on canary host. nothing critical blocking cut, but we shouldn't proceed to full rollout until canary is stable for 30m.
Anna Rivera: reviewed #2431, left one comment about the mock timing, will push a small commit in ~30m.
Ben Cho: i'll queue the cherry-pick for the docs backport once Anna's commit lands.
release-bot: [deploy] canary job started at 1987654321, job id: cb-779, status: running.
ops-bot: [alert] resource pressure on us-west-2-gpu-3 at 10:38 (mem 92%). suggested: drain noncritical pods.
Maya Patel: plan for next hour: Anna lands fix, Ben preps backport, Devon watches canary logs and autoscaler, Samir continues routing investigation. i'll re-post a short update in ~45m. react with :thumbsup: if you're aligned or drop a note if you need a deviation.
Ben Cho: :thumbsup:
Anna Rivera: will update here after push.
Devon Li: i'll tail logs and post anomalies.
Samir Khatri: continuing trace, will flag if fallback recurs.
Maya Patel: thanks team, keeping the rollout paused until 30m stable - moving to standby.
